about: Questions for evals/retrieval_eval.py, written by Claude (Fable 5.1) on 2026-10-06 from the chunks alone, before any model wrote a context. 'evidence' is a piece of text that occurs in exactly one chunk of the corpus: that chunk is the answer. 'situated' questions name the source (speaker, show, page), which the chunk itself usually does not; 'content' questions ask only about what is said; 'paraphrase' questions (added after a first run showed BM25 near 97%, still before any model context) avoid the words of the chunk.
